answer: Latent-trait carryover scoring. Each identity must, across epochs, keep its private kernel of interaction features (latency fingerprints, path choices) close to a slow-moving reference stored at a neutral wharf node. A dune-sized drift budget is allowed per epoch; exceeding it forces re-enrollment and resets accumulated trust. Sybils splitting into many fresh identities pay full re-enrollment and lose carryover credit each cycle, so farm cost scales with identity count times epoch count, not with stake.
